articles.title: Angela Hallinan, 83, Longtime Volunteer
articles.deck: Friends remember Angela Hallinan for the many years of service to Stonebridge.
body: Born in Stonebridge in the years after the war, Angela Hallinan spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.

Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Stonebridge. Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Canal Park Food Pantry in his or her name.

body: To the editor: I have lived on Kiln Court for 13 years, and I want to say what a difference the Millrace Library branch has made.

articles.deck: The vote came after 32 residents spoke at Monday’s session.
body: The ordinance will return to the agenda at the next regular session, unless the chair calls a special meeting first.

Staff recommended approval with two conditions: a traffic study and a public notice period of 30 days.
